 Honorable Chairman Gleason
Public Comment Supporting Independent Audit Request - Docket
59475, Item 6571
I support Kevin Kennedy and John M. Burrow's request in Item 6571 for an
independent technical investigation and forensic audit of the modeling underlying
the 2024 Permian Basin Reliability Plan.
Before further irreversible commitments are made, we ask the Commission to
obtain an independent evaluation of the modeling assumptions, reconcile
material differences between the PBRP and the 2024 Regional Transmission Plan,
and publicly explain whether each proposed 765-kV import path remains
justified.
We also support the requested pause while that work is completed and reviewed.
Our support for an audit does not presume misconduct or a predetermined result.
It reflects the importance of getting decisions of this magnitude correct. When
billions of dollars, thousands of acres of private land, and long-term ratepayer
obligations are at stake, Texans need confidence that the underlying models are
accurate, unbiased, and compliant with all applicable standards.
For these reasons, we respectfully urge the Commission to grant the request for
an independent technical investigation and forensic audit, and to pause further
action on the 765-kV import paths until that work is complete.

Texans deserve clarity before irreversible decisions are made.
